bounded_source_review_notes: XML Table 2 was parsed manually as a peptide-by-target MIC matrix; PDF text and methods were used to cross-check endpoint, units, inoculum, and incubation.
Supplementary landing-*.bin files are publisher HTML captures, not spreadsheet/PDF supplements; OA package contains article NXML/PDF and figures but no structured supplementary tables.
Figure-only dose curves were not converted to exact values except where prose supplies explicit numeric ranges.
